description: Search LinkedIn companies. Filter by keywords, industryId, or location. Costs 5 credits per call. Returns a single page of matching companies.

industryId.description: LinkedIn industry ID (numeric, comma-separated for several). Not an industry name — IDs are LinkedIn's industry codes (V2), listed at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/shared/references/reference-tables/industry-codes-v2

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-run the search live (costs 5 credits). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

name: linkedin_company_search
title: LinkedIn Company Search
